about: Pictures for the 1.2 drills (surprising facts, jokes, real-life scenes, formula symbols). Each picture is a worked example of a memorable image: vivid, a little funny, one clear subject. Original pixel art only, no text, letters, numbers, logos or real people. The game shows them only while studying and in feedback, never during recall. Ids are permanent once shipped; src/ui uses them through artFor(id) and shows nothing if a picture is missing.

card.note: fact and joke pictures, shown beside the text while studying

vignette.note: one per real-life scene, shown on the scene's brief

symbol.note: the formula symbol alphabet, shown on the formulae brief
